metas.name: 1 · ★ 4.0 · 1949 · Åsa-Nisse
metas.description: At a parish meeting Åsa-Nisse suggests that they should hire a common home help, who could give their wives some relief by staying one week at each household. The meeting assents and decides that the order of her rotation should be established by lot. The two bachelors of the village claim their right to the home help as well, arguing that they are also taxpayers. When Elsa Haglund arrives from Gothenburg she starts her first week of work at one of the two bachelors, the village shop-keeper Sjökvist. He is immediately infatuated by her and begins a flirtation. At the end of the week Elsa happens to meet the other bachelor, Eric Broo, called "the singing farmer". She falls in love with him, but doesn't know how to hook him, as he is very shy and unskilled in courting women. In the meantime Åsa-Nisse, the village rogue, carries out some of his pranks.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.0 · 1950 · Åsa-Nisse på jaktstigen
metas.description: Nils Nilsson from Åsen, better known as Åsa-Nisse and his friend Klabbarparn goes Moose hunting. As a result of a sabotage, staged by their wives, Åsa-Nisse is accused for hunting with illegal weapons.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.9 · 1952 · Åsa-Nisse på nya äventyr
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse advertise for Summer guests and from Stockholm arrives Mrs. Niklasson and her atlethic daughter Elsa who is currently training for the olympic games.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.9 · 1953 · Åsa-Nisse på semester
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse is visited by cousin Doris from the United States. Nisse, Klabbarparn and Doris will travel to Stockholm, but Nisse and Klabbarparn lose track of Doris, who get into a hands of a Casanova. Nisse and Klabbarparn instead ends up at the Nordic Museum, where Åsa-Nisse turns out to have unexpected qualities in the art of imitating a mannequin. After that they had found each other is Doris robbed and it leads to a wild brawl that it sparkles and sputters on.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 3.8 · 1954 · Åsa-Nisse på hal is
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse and Klabbarparn are winter fishing.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 4.0 · 1955 · Åsa-Nisse ordnar allt
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse has a bad back and when he visits the doctor he gets an experimental medicine for horses by mistake. Suddenly Åsa-Nisse has super strengths and becomes an unbeatable athlete.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 3.7 · 1956 · Åsa-Nisse flyger i luften
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse has invented a very powerful engine and he sells the patent. However, the grocery store owner Sjökvist has been sneaking around ...

metas.name: 8 · ★ 3.9 · 1957 · Åsa-Nisse i full fart
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse gets a chance to win 10.000 SEK in the biggest game show on Swedish TV.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 3.9 · 1958 · Asa Nisse in Military Uniform
metas.description: Corporal Åsa-Nisse Nilsson is an officer who somehow manages to teach his soldiers both discipline and the art of war.

metas.name: 10 · ★ 3.9 · 1960 · Åsa-Nisse som polis
metas.description: Country bailiff believes that a man of the people shall exercise police work. Åsa-Nisse appointed to the local police for some time. "Nesses" sometimes odd methods will still work somehow. Åsa-Nisse and Klabbarparn then visit Gothenburg to see the singer Gun from Knohult at Liseberg. There they also take a tour of the roller-coaster.

metas.name: 11 · ★ 3.9 · 1961 · Åsa-Nisse bland grevar och baroner
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse has found a new job as forest ranger at count Malcolms estate Segerstad.

metas.name: 12 · ★ 3.6 · 1962 · Åsa-Nisse på Mallorca
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse and Klabbarparn has found an old pirate map that leads them to the island Mallorca in the Mediterranean Sea as they search for the hidden treasure.

metas.name: 13 · ★ 3.9 · 1963 · Åsa-Nisse och tjocka släkten
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse's brother Julius returns home from USA, apparently very rich. Also, Åsa-Nisse och Klabbarparen takes care of a little child which leads to all sorts of complications.

metas.name: 14 · ★ 3.5 · 1964 · Åsa-Nisse i popform
metas.description: Pop music comes to Knohult and Åsa-Nisse has a new invention that makes his hens lay their eggs to the beat of the music.

metas.name: 15 · ★ 2.7 · 1965 · Åsa-Nisse slår till
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse and Klabbarparn with wives taking part in a jenka-contest from Knohult to Vetlanda where he reports with his homemade walkie-talkie. Then he demonstrates the "Demon-Spritzer", a self-made cement machine which then breaks down and squirts down Klabbarparn with cement. Sjökvist is robbed and bike down with his delivery-bicycle in water at a beach. The robbers then repents and wants to return the money. Features performances from artists Sten & Stanley, The Moonlighters, and Shane.

metas.name: 16 · ★ 3.3 · 1966 · Åsa-Nisse i raketform
metas.description: Inspired by the space-race, Åsa-Nisse and his friends build a top-secret moon rocket. They have big trouble hiding their secret from prying newspaper reporters, and spies disguised as cows...

metas.name: 17 · ★ 3.1 · 1967 · Åsa-Nisse i agentform
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse and Klabbarparn teach Sjökvisten how to be a secret agent.

metas.name: 18 · ★ 2.9 · 1968 · Åsa-Nisse och den stora kalabaliken
metas.description: Sjökvist needs a woman to tidy up his general store and Åsa-Nisse helps him out to put an ad in the local newspaper.

metas.name: 19 · ★ 2.5 · 1969 · Åsa-Nisse i rekordform
metas.description: Åsa-Nisse invents a new super fuel that makes boats look like rockets.

metas.name: 20 · ★ 3.5 · 2011 · Åsa-Nisse - Wälkom to Knohult
metas.description: A man from Småland finds oil in his backyard.
